30TH JUNE 2026
Learn more
NEW FEATURE
Partner Apps MCP
Connect your favourite tools directly to Slackbot to surface live data and rich interactive content right in your conversation. Instead of just pushing alerts, Slackbot proactively reaches into partner apps on your behalf so that you can actually complete work without ever leaving Slack.
NEW FEATURE
Slackbot MCP
Slackbot uses MCP to reach the tools that your team already runs on – Google, Atlassian, Box, Notion, DocuSign and more – so one conversation can pull from your entire stack. You don’t have to leave to get the answer. Slackbot reaches where the work is.
NEW FEATURE
Slackbot Memory
Slackbot remembers what actually happened before – the channels that you’re in, the decisions that your team made, the projects that shaped your work. The longer you use it, the more it knows. Week one, it knows your name. Week eight, it knows your stakeholders, your tone and what ‘urgent’ means to you.
NEW FEATURE
Slackbot Voice Dictation
For the employee who never opened Slackbot because typing felt like one more thing, you can now just say it out loud.
NEW FEATURE
Slackbot Native Charts
Numbers buried in a message are easy to miss. Now Slackbot turns raw data into visual charts inline without pivot tables, third-party tools or leaving Slack to make a point land. Share a dataset, ask a question and the insight is right there in the conversation where decisions get made.
FEATURE ENHANCEMENT
Group DM naming
Users have wanted to name their Group DMs since they launched in 2015. Now you can. Simply hover over the list of members in the DM header, click the pencil icon and give your group conversation a name – emoji included. The name you set displays for everyone in the conversation, including in Slack Connect. And just like Channels, anyone in the Group DM can rename it.
FEATURE ENHANCEMENT
Sidebar filter
Just start typing and your channel list narrows in real time. With fuzzy matching built in, partial names, typos and special characters all work. Results are sorted by recency so that your most active conversations float to the top. The filter is Group DM-aware – type a name and Group DMs with that person surface too, even closed ones. Works consistently across both the Home and DMs tabs, with a handoff to search when there are no results.
29TH MAY 2026
Read the blog
NEW FEATURE
Today view
Your day used to start with a wall of messages and no clear place to begin. Today view changes that. It’s a personalised daily briefing that pulls your priorities, calendar and most pressing tasks together from your connected apps – all in one place, before the day gets away from you. Orientate your day in Today, triage your notifications in Activity, take action with Slackbot: it’s the productivity flywheel that keeps everything moving.
NEW FEATURE
Slackbot Native Charts
Slackbot can now create visual charts based on your underlying Slack, Salesforce and connected data – just ask. No underlying report required.
NEW FEATURE
Web Search
Slackbot now searches the web and reads external links to enrich your business context with real-time public information from the web.
FEATURE ENHANCEMENT
Focus mode
Sometimes the best thing you can do to get work done is quiet the distractions. Focus mode reduces visual distractions, silences non-urgent notifications and lets you signal to teammates that you’re heads down. Set it for 30 minutes, an hour, or two — and get back to the work that actually needs your attention.
FEATURE ENHANCEMENT
Block Kit Builder updates
Building in Slack just got smoother. With the updated Block Kit, you’ll be able to build apps and agents with new components including cards, alerts, carousel, code and data tables. These components allow developers to build high-density, interactive UIs for agents without writing custom code. They render natively across desktop and mobile, ensuring that data remains comprehensible and actionable.
NEW FEATURE
Miles Davis in Slack Experience
New Miles Davis-inspired backgrounds, visual effects and emoji reactions give every call a little more soul during your huddles. Just like a jazz ensemble, great collaboration happens when everyone finds their groove together. Now, Slack gives your team the perfect soundtrack to do it.
NEW FEATURE
Slack comes included with every new Salesforce org
Every new Enterprise Edition and Unlimited Edition Salesforce org now comes with a Slack free workspace – already connected, already configured, ready to go. Salesforce channels are enabled on key record pages out of the box, so teams can start collaborating in context from day one.
NEW FEATURE
Salesforce Actions in Slackbot
Your CRM just got a lot more conversational. Users can now ask Slackbot to create or update Salesforce records without ever leaving Slack. Slackbot supports actions on one or multiple records at a time – draft the change, review an interactive preview and approve before anything is saved. Admins control which objects Slackbot can write to, and every action is tracked in audit logs.
NEW FEATURE
New Welcome Mat
Slackbot Home Updates introduces a personalised welcome mat with upcoming meetings, recommended Skills and examples of how teammates are using Slackbot. New users can ramp up faster, while experienced users discover new ways to work smarter.
Embedded AI
Slackbot Across Slack embeds AI assistance directly into the flow of work. Use AI Explain to break down complex messages, Profile Summaries to quickly understand teammates and File Summaries to preview shared documents before opening them – and then follow up with Slackbot for any additional questions or next steps.
